fields.Name: T285 - File Grid Local Name Filter
fields.Description: Tests FileGridComponent's client-side applyFilters() name-substring filter (searchQuery + clearSearch), which filters an in-memory storage-object listing — a completely different implementation from the entity grid's server-backed quick-search.

InputDefinition.goal: In the File Browser (open it via the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, then 'Browse Files'), locate the file grid's 'Search files and folders...' text box at the top of the listing panel and type a few characters into it. Success is confirming the file listing RESPONDS to the typed text — the visible items narrow to name matches, OR a 'This folder is empty' / no-match state appears — and that a clear (x) button appears to reset the filter. If no storage account is configured, seeing the 'No storage accounts configured' state is an acceptable pass. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: A 'Search files and folders...' input is present in the file listing panel and accepts typed text

After typing, the listing responds (items narrow to matches or an empty/no-match state shows) and a clear (x) control becomes available — OR a clear 'No storage accounts configured' empty state is shown
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
